items.title: Sidebar

items.name: sonner
items.title: Sonner
items.description: A toast notification provider using the Sonner library with theme-aware styling.

items.name: switch

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: A tabbed interface with list, trigger, and content panels supporting default and line variants.

items.name: toggle
items.title: Toggle
items.description: A two-state button for on/off toggling with variants and sizes.

items.name: toggle-group
items.title: Toggle Group
items.description: A group of toggle buttons for multi-selection with connected or separated styling.

items.name: ds-combobox
items.title: Combobox UI
items.description: A batteries-included combobox with virtual scrolling, search, single/multi-select, groups, custom option rendering, and configurable popover positioning (side/align/offset).

items.name: ds-drawer
items.title: Drawer UI
items.description: A full-featured drawer wrapper with optional header, scrollable body, footer, direction-aware close button, snap points, scale background, and escape/pointer-down-outside event handlers.

items.name: ds-modal
items.title: Modal
items.description: A flexible modal dialog built on Dialog with size variants (sm/md/lg/xl/2xl/full), intent system (default/destructive/success/warning/info), defaultOpen for uncontrolled usage, scrollable body, auto async confirm tracking, loading skeleton, escape/pointer-down-outside/interact-outside event handlers, and i18n support.

items.name: page-loader
items.title: Page Loader
items.description: Full-page loading overlay with two variants: a shimmer bar fixed at the top of the viewport (bar) and a centered XL spinner (spinner). Controlled by a single loading prop with fade-in/out transition, semantic color options, and i18n support.

items.name: icon-button
items.title: Icon Button
items.description: An icon-only button with optional tooltip, loading state, size and rounded variants built on the Button and Tooltip primitives.

items.name: dashbox
items.title: Dashbox
items.description: A structured dashboard card with collapse/expand, fullscreen, refresh, loading skeleton, status badge, and configurable body padding.

items.name: dashrow
items.title: Dashrow
items.description: Responsive layout container for dashboard panels with resizable split ratios and N-child support.

items.name: card-stat-shared
items.title: Card Stat Shared
items.description: Shared utilities, CVA variants, and helper components (TrendBadge, CardStatEmptySlot) for the card-stat family.

items.name: card-stat
items.title: Card Stat
items.description: A statistical display card with label, value, trend indicator, optional icon, and loading skeleton.

items.name: card-stat-compact
items.title: Card Stat Compact
items.description: A compact statistical card with trend badge, description, icon, and loading skeleton.

items.name: card-stat-progress
items.title: Card Stat Progress
items.description: A statistical card with an embedded progress bar for showing completion or attainment levels.

items.name: card-stat-comparison
items.title: Card Stat Comparison
items.description: A side-by-side comparison card for current vs. previous period values with trend indicators.

items.name: card-stat-sparkline
items.title: Card Stat Sparkline
items.description: A statistical card with an inline sparkline chart for visual trend representation.

items.name: card-stat-highlight
items.title: Card Stat Highlight
items.description: A high-emphasis statistical card with a colored background for key metric prominence.

items.name: card-stat-list
items.title: Card Stat List
items.description: A statistical card containing a list of labeled items with icons and trend indicators.

items.name: card-stat-gauge
items.title: Card Stat Gauge
items.description: A statistical card with a gauge visualization for showing metrics within a target range.

items.name: card-stat-heatbar
items.title: Card Stat Heatbar
items.description: A statistical card with a segmented heatbar visualization for multi-zone metric display.

items.name: card-stats
items.title: Card Stats (All)
items.description: A portfolio of all statistical display cards: CardStat, CardStatCompact, CardStatProgress, CardStatComparison, CardStatSparkline, CardStatHighlight, CardStatList, CardStatGauge, and CardStatHeatbar.

items.name: card-icon
items.title: Card Icon
items.description: Feature / navigation card with a tinted icon medallion, title and description. Icon colour and background derive from a single semantic tone token. Supports soft/solid/outline media styles, three sizes, centred or left alignment, badge, link mode with hover lift, and a loading skeleton.

items.name: progress-bar
items.title: Progress Bar
items.description: Horizontal progress indicator with animated fill, configurable label positions, size presets, custom fill/track color overrides via CSS tokens, getValueLabel for custom label formatting, max prop, and semantic color intents. Built on the Radix UI Progress primitive.

items.name: progress-circular
items.title: Progress Circular
items.description: Displays progress as a circular gauge with an animated stroke and centered value.

items.name: risk-level-bar
items.title: Risk Level Bar
items.description: A segmented progress bar with a movable marker. Uses semantic tokens (--risk-1 to --risk-4) for flexible theming.

items.name: score-row
items.title: Score Row
items.description: A scored list item pairing icon + label with a fractional score and optional progress bar. Includes ScoreRowList container for grouped items.

items.name: scroll-to-top
items.title: Scroll to Top
items.description: Floating button with scroll-progress ring that reveals when scrolling upward past a threshold. Smart direction-aware visibility, Tooltip, i18n support, and multiple positions.

items.name: mini-card
items.title: Mini Card
items.description: Compact stat label+value unit for horizontal summary strips. Compose with MiniCardGroup (pill, outlined, elevated, ghost variants) and MiniCardStrip (auto-dividers). Supports icons, sub-values, intent colors, and delta change indicators. Size propagates via context.

items.name: pill-group
items.title: Pill Group
items.description: A horizontal filter bar with pill-shaped toggle buttons, item counts, per-item intent colors, icon support, and automatic scroll overflow with fade indicators.

items.name: step-progress
items.title: Step Progress
items.description: A visual guide through a sequential multi-step process with horizontal and vertical orientations.

items.name: bar-chart
items.title: Bar Chart
items.description: A fully featured bar chart with tooltips, legend, stacking, rounded corners, and brush zoom.

items.name: boxplot-chart
items.title: Boxplot Chart
items.description: A fully custom SVG box-and-whisker chart with ResizeObserver for responsive layout, notch support, and outlier plotting.

items.name: candlestick-chart
items.title: Candlestick Chart
items.description: A financial candlestick chart with volume bars, moving averages, reference lines, and brush zoom.

items.name: geomap-chart
items.title: Geomap Chart
items.description: A geographic map component for rendering GeoJSON/TopoJSON data with tooltips, zooming, choropleth, and point markers.

items.name: heatmap-chart
items.title: Heatmap Chart
items.description: A responsive heatmap chart built with pure CSS grid and color-mix for smooth color interpolation.

items.name: line-chart
items.title: Line Chart
items.description: A responsive line chart with plain lines, gradient area fills, stacked areas, reference lines, and brush zoom.

items.name: pie-chart
items.title: Pie Chart
items.description: A responsive pie and donut chart with interactive center label, legend, and outer slice labels.

items.name: radar-chart
items.title: Radar Chart
items.description: A responsive radar (spider) chart for comparing multiple entities across the same set of dimensions.

items.name: radial-chart
items.title: Radial Chart
items.description: A responsive radial bar chart with concentric rings, single-metric gauge mode, and legend support.

items.name: scatter-chart
items.title: Scatter Chart
items.description: A responsive scatter and bubble chart with trend lines, multi-series, and brush zoom.

items.name: treemap-chart
items.title: Treemap Chart
items.description: A responsive treemap chart with hierarchical drill-down, breadcrumb navigation, and aspect ratio control.

items.name: counter
items.title: Counter
items.description: A precision numeric input with button controls, direct keyboard entry support, and inputProps passthrough for native HTML attributes.

items.name: input-email
items.title: Input Email
items.description: An email input field with a built-in mail icon and customizable size and radius variants.

items.name: input-password
items.title: Input Password
items.description: A secure password input field with a toggle visibility button and custom size/radius options.

items.name: select-list
items.title: Select List
items.description: A searchable list of items with selection state, support for groups, icons and virtual scrolling behavior.

items.name: footer-menu
items.title: Footer Menu
items.description: A responsive footer navigation that displays in columns on desktop and as an accordion on mobile.

items.name: header-search
items.title: Header Search
items.description: An expandable search button for use in page headers with smooth transition animations.

items.name: nav-dots
items.title: Nav Dots
items.description: Dot-based section navigation with automatic scroll tracking and tooltips.

items.name: nav-user
items.title: Nav User
items.description: A user profile dropdown menu for navigation headers, built on DropdownMenu and Avatar.

items.name: toggle-theme
items.title: Toggle Theme
items.description: A dropdown button to switch between light, dark, and system themes. Re-exports ThemeProvider for app-level setup.

items.name: search-bar
items.title: Search Bar
items.description: A full-width composable search bar with visual variants, keyboard shortcut hint, voice input, debounce, custom icon, and skeleton loading.

items.name: search-combo
items.title: Search Combo
items.description: A search field with autocomplete dropdown, keyboard navigation, grouped results, voice recognition, and text highlighting.

items.name: data-table
items.title: Data Table
items.description: A high-performance virtualized data table with built-in toolbar, pagination, and sorting capabilities.

items.name: ds-spinner
items.title: Spinner UI
items.description: An animated loader with locale-aware aria-labels, built on lucide-react Loader2Icon.

items.name: ds-pagination
items.title: Pagination UI
items.description: A pagination component with locale-aware aria labels, prev/next links, and ellipsis support.

items.name: ds-badge
items.title: Badge UI
items.description: Extended badge with dot indicator, removable close icon, icon support, counter/overflow display, and semantic color variants (success/warning).

items.name: ds-empty
items.title: Empty UI
items.description: Contextual empty states with built-in SVG icons for no-data, search, error, and no-results scenarios, i18n titles, action button, compact mode, and skeleton loading.

items.name: ds-switch
items.title: Switch UI
items.description: Extended switch with label positioning, semantic color variants (success/destructive/warning), skeleton loading, and error state.

items.name: ds-accordion
items.title: Accordion UI
items.description: Extended accordion with icon style variants (chevron/plus/arrow/sign), size variants, rounded/bordered CVA, discriminated single/multiple types with collapsible control, i18n aria-labels, skeleton loading, and nested accordion support.

items.name: ds-input
items.title: Input UI
items.description: Extended input with icon prefix/suffix, clearable button, character counter with maxLength, loading spinner, i18n labels, and error state.

items.name: ds-avatar
items.title: Avatar UI
items.description: Extended avatar with size scale (sm through 2xl), status indicator dots, initials color generator, image loading status callback, delay fallback, avatar group with overflow count, tooltip, and skeleton loading.

items.name: ds-slider
items.title: Slider UI
items.description: Extended slider with value tooltip on hover, step marks/labels, range (dual handle) support, format-utils integration, i18n aria-labels, and skeleton loading.

items.name: ds-select
items.title: Select UI
items.description: Extended select with search filter, async option loading, grouped options, creatable new option, configurable popover positioning (side/align/offset), i18n placeholder/no-results, and skeleton loading.

items.name: ds-button
items.title: Button UI
items.description: Feature-rich button with loading state, start/end icons, rounded variant (full/lg/md/none), fullWidth, double-click debounce, two-step destructive confirmation, and built-in tooltip via Radix. Wraps the shadcn Button primitive.

items.name: ds-carousel
items.title: Carousel UI
items.description: Extended carousel with autoplay support via embla-carousel-autoplay, multiple nav variants (side/overlay/bottom/none), card/showcase/minimal display modes, dot indicators, responsive slides-per-view, external API control via setApi, i18n aria-labels, and skeleton loading. Wraps the shadcn Carousel primitive.

items.name: ds-tabs
items.title: Tabs UI
items.description: Extended tabs with 4 variants (default/line/pill/segmented), 3 sizes, icons, count badges, loading skeletons, vertical orientation, activation mode (automatic/manual), and responsive accordion fallback on mobile. Wraps the shadcn Tabs primitive.

items.name: attachment
items.title: Attachment
items.description: A file attachment component with support for media preview, title, description, actions, trigger overlay, and group layout. Composed of AttachmentGroup, AttachmentMedia, AttachmentContent, AttachmentTitle, AttachmentDescription, AttachmentActions, AttachmentAction, and AttachmentTrigger sub-components.

items.name: bubble
items.title: Bubble
items.description: A chat bubble component with support for sent/received variants, tail indicators, and group layout. Composed of BubbleGroup sub-component.

items.name: marker
items.title: Marker
items.description: A status and pin marker indicator for chat and list items with support for variant, pin, and side-by-side layout.

items.name: message
items.title: Message
items.description: A chat message component with support for align (start/end), avatar, content, header, and footer slots. Composed of MessageGroup, MessageAvatar, MessageContent, MessageHeader, and MessageFooter sub-components.

items.name: message-scroller
items.title: Message Scroller
items.description: An auto-scrolling container for chat message lists with scroll-to-end/start buttons, visibility detection, and virtualized content support. Composed of MessageScrollerProvider, MessageScrollerViewport, MessageScrollerContent, MessageScrollerItem, and MessageScrollerButton sub-components.

items.name: questionnaire
items.title: Questionnaire
items.description: A multi-step questionnaire with single-choice, multiple-choice, freeform, and skippable questions. Owns the ordered items, active item, answer state, validation, progress, and navigation. Composed of QuestionnaireItem, QuestionnaireProgress, QuestionnaireTitle, QuestionnaireDescription, QuestionnaireChoices, QuestionnaireChoice, QuestionnaireChoiceDescription, QuestionnaireInput, QuestionnaireError, QuestionnaireActions, QuestionnairePrevious, QuestionnaireSkip, QuestionnaireNext, and QuestionnaireSubmit sub-components.
